title: Pullback theorem and rigidity for Sobolev mappings on Carnot groups
summary: This paper establishes a pullback theorem via mollification to extend the rigidity theory of Sobolev mappings between Carnot groups to the low-integrability regime where the Sobolev exponent $p$ is less than the homogeneous dimension $ν_1$ of the source group. The core technical achievement is the rigorous analysis of the convergence of mollified approximations $f_\varepsilon$ for a mapping $f \in W^{1,p}$, demonstrating that the pullbacks of left-invariant differential forms converge appropriately.
